{{Quote|The Mandalorians attacked the Hutt palace in record time. By sheer coincidence, I was there to sweep in and clear out the Hutt's medpacs.|Doc|<ref name="Anonymous" />}}
Sometime between [[3647 BBY|3647]]<ref name="Codex" />&ndash;[[3642 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], a [[Unidentified Mandalorian clan (Cold War)|clan]] of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warriors '''attacked''' the [[Unidentified Hutt's palace|palace]] of a [[Unidentified Hutt (medpacs)|Hutt]] whom they believed had signed a [[Death mark/Legends|death mark]] against them. The combat [[Medic/Legends|medic]] [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Archiban Kimble]], better known as Doc, had faked the death mark in order to trick the Mandalorians into attacking the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], who had been hoarding [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]] after a recent [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquake]]. During the fighting, Doc infiltrated the palace and made off with the medpacs, and the battle ended with the [[Death/Legends|death]] of both the entire clan and the Hutt.<ref name="Anonymous" />

==Behind the scenes==
The unnamed Hutt was first mentioned in the conversation "Anonymous" with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] companion character Doc in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Anonymous" />
